decisions.reason: Locates declaration/target/applier; uses API-08 to classify cordis.patch.yml as composition (negative control) versus the real host-source patch; ties the patch target to the private SessionView import under the same card.

Locates producer/consumer and ignorable:true; explains A1-02 removal / A2-01 restoration folding, keeps the marker, and correctly notes Session.append still cannot write it (API-05) rather than claiming it can.

Locates apiProxy usage and its removal (A1-01); applies the API-01 plane rule to inject the host llm domain service (listProviders) and warns against the nonexistent client-plane remote injection on the host plane.
Locates the hardcoded path and prescribes runtime DSH_HOME/profile resolution; explicitly notes --profile already existed at rc.2, so no false alpha.1 introduction claim.
Locates both the /internal import and command registration; prescribes exact-tag comparison and rebuilding imports by owning module with no stable public seam marked pending rather than guessed.
Locates the loopback server; states loopback is not a reason to skip auth and distinguishes raw routes from the host-managed authenticated gate (requestRejection / Connection seams).
Locates both wrappers; explains stdout final text vs stderr reasoning segments and explicitly attributes the JSONL assumption as a pre-existing defect (R-06 baseline), not an alpha.2 stdout change.

Maps source patch/UI to A1-03, events to A2-01 with A1-02 as intermediate-only, services to A1-01, host dir to A1-04, channel to A1-08, subprocess to A1-05 — matching the rubric with grounded per-touchpoint reasoning.
All seven categories hit with no no-hit class, heuristics/limits stated, and a concrete plan of typecheck/build, isolated cold boot, and per-hit functional checks proposed as proposed-only.
